cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Content & Creative Specialist position at Televic Conference. Your mission to help customers understand why the right technology makes a difference aligns with my approach to content: making complex ideas simple, relevant, and engaging.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I write SEO blog posts and manage CMS content for client websites, including WordPress and Shopify stores. I've built and optimized sites like mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and ran technical SEO audits to improve search visibility. Freelance, I designed and built baverok.com from scratch, combining hand-coded elements with WordPress to create a site that showcases my writing and visual work.

My technical background—front-end development and computer science coursework—gives me a solid understanding of how products work, which helps me translate technical details into clear stories. I use AI tools daily for research and content creation, always checking accuracy and brand consistency. I also have experience with Canva for visual assets and basic video editing.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, within a realistic commute to Izegem, and I'm available to work on-site three days a week. I'm eager to bring my writing and visual skills to Televic Conference and contribute to content that connects with audiences worldwide.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can help your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
